# Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated, and all tests passing
- [ ] Documentation updated (README, ADRs, inline docs)
- [ ] Environment variables documented (if any new vars introduced)
- [ ] Breaking changes called out explicitly (if applicable)
- [ ] Follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) specification

---

# Labels

<!-- Request reviewers to apply appropriate labels -->

- [ ] `breaking` — introduces breaking changes
- [ ] `feature` — new functionality
- [ ] `bugfix` — fixes a bug
- [ ] `docs` — documentation only
- [ ] `refactor` — code restructuring without behaviour change
- [ ] `chore` — maintenance, tooling, config
